name: KuroCodeAgent
tagline: Autonomous Local-First AI Terminal Assistant & OS Copilot
description: An autonomous desktop terminal agent designed to plan, execute, verify, heal, and evolve directly on your machine with deterministic safety gates.
highlights: Deterministic verification with py_compile and exit code checking
Encrypted credential vault via Windows DPAPI / AES-256
Dynamic hot-loading of custom tools, plugins, and skills
Multi-provider failover across Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and Ollama

name: Kuro Hub
tagline: Public Capability Registry for Tools, Plugins, Skills & Integrations
description: The open capability distribution registry that catalogs verified extensions, diagnostic utilities, and procedural workflows for the KuroLabs ecosystem.
highlights: Decoupled registry of 25+ verified developer capabilities
Native sync with KuroCodeAgent via /hub and /store commands
Typed manifests for tools, plugins, procedural skills, and external bridges
Open for community contributions through standardized PR workflows
